feeds.title: The Vienna Blog
feeds.description: This is a Travel and Lifestyle Blog about Vienna and beyondTheViennaBlog launched in April 2010, when its author, Greg Sideris, decided to publish his vast travel knowledge to benefit friends, family and the wider online community.

feeds.title: 1000 Things to do in Austria
feeds.description: The best discounts & tips from culinary, leisure and nightlife in Austria. Find Excursion tips & inspiration for Vienna and Austria. Discover the best places, the coolest activities and secret spots.

feeds.title: Gates of Vienna
feeds.description: Find articles on historical conflicts in Vienna over religions and cultural revolution, news centered in Vienna and changes that happened since the last war in the city.

feeds.title: Goodnight
feeds.description: We'll show you our favorite places, the nicest cafés and the newest clubs. We know which party you can't miss tomorrow and where you can get the best breakfast afterwards. We love Vienna by day and by night. Even in winter. The digital city magazine for Vienna with local guide and event calendar.

feeds.title: The Viennese Girl
feeds.description: Best Vienna blog Lifestyle, Travel tips, photography. For sophisticated travelers. This blog opens a door to the world and celebrates new beginnings, changes and challenges - all the small and big things that bring joy to life. My vision is to keep it positive, playful, and multidimensional, and to bring value to others lives by creating useful and interesting content.

feeds.title: WU Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the WU Blog! Here you will find a series of blog posts by students, researchers, teachers, alumni and employees - get involved. WU is an international university that is very aware of its responsibility to society and the research community and acts conscientiously in all that it does.

feeds.title: Universität Wien Blog
feeds.description: The Uni Wien blog offers space for a colorful collection of stories from studies, research and teaching of all the people who make our university what it is. With 6,900 academics at 20 faculties and centres, the University provides strong impetus by presenting novel findings and developing innovative solutions. In the field of research, it cooperates with industry, cultural institutions and society. Approximately 10,000 students graduate from the University of Vienna every year.

feeds.title: Magenta Telekom Blog
feeds.description: Insights into the Magenta world and connected life, service tips and stories about the digital lifestyle. Magenta Telekom (T-Mobile Austria GmbH) is a leading provider of Internet, mobile communications, entertainment and business solutions in Austria.

feeds.title: DIALOG Blog
feeds.description: You can find out exciting, funny and useful things about languages on our blog, get great learning tips and language hacks and update yourself about news and events in our school. DIALOG - DER SPRACHCAMPUS specializes in language training in the adult education sector. In our training programs, we focus primarily on practical and interpersonal experiences.

feeds.title: Wiener Wohnsinn Blog
feeds.description: Blog Wiener Wohnsinn on Interior Design & Lifestyle. Find all blog articles from the categories Living, Kids, Home stories, Travel Diaries and Recipes. I am Melanie. 37 years old, native of Carinthia, mother of two extraordinary teenagers and in a relationship with an architect who shares my sense and sense of aesthetics.

feeds.title: Vienna Center for Logic and Algorithms
feeds.description: Explore research done in the areas of logic, philosophy, mathematics, computer science, and artificial intelligence among the general public alike. The annual reports offer a detailed overview of all VCLA activities. Vienna Center for Logic and Algorithms is an initiative of TU Wien, enhancing open academic exchange across the fields of logic and algorithms while promoting the role of computer sciences among the experts and laymen alike.

feeds.title: Viennissima Lifestyle
feeds.description: Viennissima Blogazine is like a concept store for me, in which you will find lifestyle tips on art, culture, crafts and cuisine that I have selected and passionately researched. I'll tell you about exclusive (new) restaurants, bars and boutique hotels in Vienna, give you my very personal shopping tips for interior design & fashion stores and tell you about precious craftsmanship 'made in Austria'.

feeds.title: From Coffee With Love
feeds.description: Welcome to From Coffee With Love, in which I present in a fun and enjoyable reading manner about all things coffee, from a love perspective of course.

feeds.title: MaryJay
feeds.description: I have been reporting regularly on current fashion and beauty trends and lifestyle topics under the new name MaryJay and in a new design. Since I am a trained event marketer myself, sooner or later it was obvious to add the events category to my blog topics. You will also find numerous follow-up reports from selected bloggers, press and/or sports and music events here on my blog. My name is Jasmin Maria (Mary Jay), actually from Lower Austria, but I have been living and working in beautiful Vienna since 2009.

feeds.title: Wien mit Kind
feeds.description: Find travel and food guides with articles on mom life strewn in. A blog published by a mom traveling around with kids and testing the limits with different culinary experiences.

feeds.title: Vienna Cultgram Blog
feeds.description: A Vienna-based personal blog about culture, arts, travel and my photography. I am a world citizen based in Vienna (which also happens to be where I grew up). Here I present personal impressions about Vienna´s nature and cultural offerings, with a little more background information than I am able to give on Instagram.

feeds.title: Vienna Insider
feeds.description: We share our personal tips, experiences and impressions from the gorgeous Austrian capital Vienna with our worldwide readers. Our mission is to show you not merely touristy sights, cafes, corners and restaurants, but most of all cool insider places, that will make your visit or life in Vienna a bit more interesting and inspiring. Our goal is to inspire people to explore their places of living, wherever that may be. Let's be curious, creative, avoid living a routine, embrace life and look for beauty in everything that surrounds us.

feeds.title: CheckVienna
feeds.description: Plan your trip to Vienna! On our CheckVIENNA blog you will find many useful inside tips for the perfect holiday in Vienna. With over 200 fully furnished apartments in Vienna, checkVIENNA is one of the leading providers of holiday apartments and temporary accommodation in the federal capital.

feeds.title: Sommertage
feeds.description: Personal travel blog from Austria. We'll tell you our best tips for individual trips around the world. On our travel blog, we share with you our passion for travelling and photography. Both adventures from afar and those right on our doorstep.

feeds.title: Vienna Residence Blog
feeds.description: Explore blogs for new property listings, projects, things to do in Vienna and more! Vienna Residence has extensive experience in short and long-term rentals for upscale requirements.

feeds.title: TEDxVienna Magazine
feeds.description: Get to know us better and stay up to date with our inspiring articles, beyond the ideas of TEDx. Our team of talented writers, editors, and proofreaders is dedicated to creating interesting content, for the intellectually curious who are eager to learn more about the ever-changing world around them.

feeds.title: Pop Up Girl
feeds.description: Hey my name is Catharina (aka Cat) and I'm glad to welcome you on my food and lifestyle blog. Here you will find not only the most diverse recipes, but also travel reports, a little on the subject of fashion and beauty and actually everything that moves me in my life just like that.

feeds.title: Vienna Book And Travel » Blog
feeds.description: We recommend books to read, off the beaten track, customized itineraries, and provide insights based on our own trips and/or our in-depth readings. Hi! We are Ilinca, Anca, and Sinan - cultural family travelers in Vienna! Join us to discover our amazing city and how you can lead a travel-inspired lifestyle.

feeds.title: Valentina in Shorts
feeds.description: Your lifestyle and travel inspirations from Vienna, Austria. A blog with stories and tips about travel, food, style and happy things. 'Valentina in shorts' is your inspirational Lifestyle and Travel Blog from Vienna, Austria. I am a girl who moved to Vienna after a Master´s degree in Architecture.

feeds.title: Fashionway Blog
feeds.description: As a blogger I try to present my views toward current trends, fashion styles, talk about the business in general and try to show some of the outfits I am working with at any given time. My name is Diana Filipova and I am a fashion blogger, model and designer.

feeds.title: Deutsch Akademie Blog
feeds.description: Discover students stories, experiences in the blog along with news from the academy. The DeutschAkademie in Vienna offers high-quality German courses in small groups of 7-12 participants.

feeds.title: Secret Vienna Blog
feeds.description: Follow Secret Vienna and learn about the history, secrets and legends of Vienna! Read the stories about Vienna's history and join our Vienna walking tours. Secret Vienna is a tourism company devoted to the exploration of the wonderful city of Vienna. We offer tours in 11 languages, experiences, outdoor adventures, workshops and masterclasses.

feeds.title: Elleundspeiche
feeds.description: Explore articles about fashion, beauty, interior and the Viennese lifestyle.

feeds.title: Vienna Textile Lab Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog to know more about our experiments, new colors, textiles and more. Vienna Textile Lab fabricates organic colors made by naturally occurring bacteria in order to provide the most sustainable, wholesome and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional synthetic colors.

feeds.title: Vienna Global Leaders Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with VGL Forums and workshops with our blog. Vienna Global Leaders is a platform by EUNEPA dedicated to developing and connecting managers and leaders in a complex world.

feeds.title: Ristorante-scala
feeds.description: Find tips and advice on various cooking techniques, our recipes and more. Enjoy pasta, meat, fish or wine at the best price either in the beautiful garden in summer or inside of the restaurant in winter. Organize weddings, baptisms, company gatherings, Christmas parties, business lunches in our cantina (cellar parlor) directly under the restaurant for up to 40 people.

feeds.title: Research Center for the History of Transformations Blog
feeds.description: The Transformative Blog provides informative insights for a global intellectual audience. Read about social, economic,and cultural transformations in the region with a global perspective and wide scope of interest from current affairs to historical analysis on Central and Eastern Europe, East Asia and the co-transformation of Western countries. An institute for advanced research that takes the year 1989 as a starting point to think about social, economic, and cultural transformations in the wake of deep historical caesuras on a European and global scale.

feeds.title: The Curmudgeon in the Cottage
feeds.description: Articles featuring Meanderings of a grumpy social observer in Vienna's Cottageviertel. About life in Vienna from a long-term Briton living in Vienna for three years. Full of social comment, a modicum of irreverence, and posts that are intended to be relaxingly read over a coffee.

feeds.title: Green Labs Austria Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest articles on research done by the institute. Non-profit organization rooted at the University of Vienna and founded to support and develop sustainable life science practices. Green Labs Austria aims to connect Austrian and international laboratories that share the vision of sustainable research.

feeds.title: Disi Couture
feeds.description: Disi Couture is a professional blog specializing in fashion, travel and lifestyle, boasting a loyal global audience. Founded by Edisa Shahini in September 2010, with this blog she will continue to encourage and inspire readers all over the world. Behind Disi Couture stands Edisa, known by the name 'Disi' and for her impeccable style, tireless devotion to fashion and art.

feeds.title: Vienna Sunday Kitchen
feeds.description: As the name Vienna Sunday Kitchen wants to show, the blog is about cooking for celebrations, for sunny Sundays, for happy holidays with friends and family. Therefore it mainly focuses on my Granny's recipes as well as Viennese and Austrian recipes that you do not prepare every day (and indeed should not eat every day necessarily).

feeds.title: Impact Hub Vienna Blog
feeds.description: Read inspiring stories from entrepreneurs in our local and global community, upcoming events, funding opportunities, and more. At Impact Hub Vienna, our mission is to connect, enable, and inspire businesses that innovate with heart, balancing social responsibility with profitability to build a world that works for all.

feeds.title: Mumok Blog
feeds.description: The mumok blog features current content in the areas mumok mini, mumok live, mumok collects, and mumok insider. The mumok is the largest museum in central Europe for art since modern times.

feeds.title: Austrian Music Export
feeds.description: Austrian Music Export is a service and resource center for exporters of contemporary Austrian music in all genres and aspects (recordings, live, sync, etc.). This includes providing access to information on Austrian artists and companies, building a substantial network of industry professionals and media, providing travel support and representing Austrian music at international trade shows, conferences and festivals.
